quarterly_data.signal: At its 2026 Financial Analyst Meeting Everpure provided a preliminary outlook for fiscal year 2028: revenue $7.0B to $7.3B (39% to 45% year-over-year growth) and non-GAAP operating income $1.7B to $1.9B (80% to 100% year-over-year growth). Forward-looking; the company says actual results may differ materially.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everpure press release: Everpure's Expanding Business Model Fuels New Long-Term (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Everpure outlined four strategic growth vectors: Core and Core AI (FlashBlade, Flash Array and Evergreen//One subscriptions, both CPU- and GPU-attached); Modern Data Software (Everpure Data Intelligence, Data Stream, Portworx, Resilience, Everpure Cloud); Scale AI (FlashBlade//EXA solutions tailored for neoclouds and AI-native providers); and Hyperscale Solutions (DirectFlash technology designed specifically for hyperscalers). Core and Core AI is projected to continue gaining market share, and the three new vectors (Modern Data Software, Scale AI, Hyperscale Solutions) are expected to represent approximately 20% of total revenue by fiscal year 2030. Over the past five years Everpure has dedicated on average 19% of annual revenue to R&D (non-GAAP). Capital framework: fund organic investment, strengthen the balance sheet, pursue strategic M&A, buy back shares to offset stock-based-compensation dilution, plus additional select buybacks to return excess capital.
quarterly_data.figure: New growth vectors ~20% of total revenue by fiscal year 2030; R&D averaged 19% of annual revenue over five years (non-GAAP)
